author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
title: The Secret Garden
edition: New York: Frederick A. Stokes Company, August 1911, as explicitly dated in the transcribed front matter. Project Gutenberg transcription; only prose line-wrap whitespace is collapsed to single spaces, paragraph boundaries and punctuation are retained; embedded verse retains its line breaks. Illustrations, captions, front matter and digitizer notes are not selected. The library text holds all twenty-seven chapters; chapter numbers are joined with their titles as headings, and the star dividers between sections are kept.

rights.basis: The selected original-English text is from the 1911 edition described above, before 1931. Project Gutenberg explicitly lists this ebook as public domain in the USA; no modern editorial introduction or illustrations are reproduced.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg plain text (eBook 17396, UTF-8, CRLF normalised to LF) from the PG mirror. Kept Chapters I–XXVII up to “THE END”; removed the PG header and footer, the title, copyright and contents pages and [Illustration] placeholders. Blank-line separated paragraphs were joined with single spaces at line ends, keeping spacing inside lines and the transcription’s _underscore_ italics; the indented letters are prose (salutation, body and signature each one paragraph); indented verse is a stanza with the transcription’s lines and indentation kept; the star dividers between sections stay as one-line paragraphs; each chapter number is joined with its title in one heading. Converted by a scratch Node script; every nightly reading was located exactly.
